summary: A flat white fuel canopy with a red brand stripe stands on four slim columns over two pump islands. Behind it is a low flat-roofed store: a glass-fronted white shop under a red sign fascia and cantilever awning, beside a taller grey service block. A red-and-black price pylon stands at the street corner. The canopy, the pumps under it, the pylon and the glass shop behind the forecourt make it read as a gas station at a glance.
concept_subject: A modern roadside gas station on a flat 42x38 lot, its front facing a two-lane asphalt street with a yellow dashed centre line and a pale smooth-stone sidewalk with two wide curb cuts. Across the front of the dark matte asphalt forecourt floats a large flat canopy, 29 blocks wide and 12 deep, about 3 blocks thick. Its fascia is bright white concrete with a single continuous red stripe around it. A small red-and-white brand roundel stands out from the centre of the street side. The underside is smooth white quartz set with a grid of glowing sea lanterns. The canopy rests on four slim white quartz columns on two raised grey pump islands. Each island has two grey fuel pumps with screens, plus yellow bollards at both ends. Behind the forecourt sits the single-storey convenience store, flat-roofed and in two volumes. On the left is a white shop with a full-height light-blue glass storefront divided by black mullions, with double glass doors in the centre and a thin white cantilever awning over it. Above the awning is a red fascia band with white 'MART' letters. On the right is a taller grey concrete service block with a narrow recessed slot window, a red logo square, and rooftop HVAC units behind its parapet. Both roofs have smooth-stone coping and a thin rail. A black plinth course runs along the base of the store. An ice chest and a caged propane rack stand in front of the grey block. A tall price pylon stands on the east grass verge: a red head with a white roundel above a black price board in a white frame. Grass verges with birch trees line both sides. There are three parking stalls with EV chargers on the west, a grey dumpster enclosure and an air/water station on the east, and a flowering azalea hedge along the back.
concept_size: 42 wide, 38 deep, 1 storey (store 7–9 high, canopy 9 high, pylon 13 high)
